confirmed_software_defect: SDA-low preflight repeats without a bus-clear path; no START/STOP/clocks can escape this state
likely_trigger: Controller reset while powered target was mid-read; plausible, not physically proven
correction: One OFF/low-bus attempt: release OD pins, nine SCL clocks with SDA released, NACK then STOP, verify both HIGH, restore AF/ODR

primary_sources.finding: SDA LOW bus clear uses nine clock pulses; escalate to target reset/power-cycle only if still held

primary_sources.section: 39.4.6 and CR1.PE; local ST LL API note
primary_sources.finding: PE0 resets controller and releases SCL/SDA; it does not clock/reset the separate target
Corroborating example of target left holding SDA after controller reset; not bench-specific proof
